pipelines.name: GDACS/ADAM Pipeline
pipelines.description: Retrieve [GDACS](https://www.gdacs.org/) cyclone events and WFP ADAM exposure and match them to NHC storms

columns.name: gdacs_eventid
columns.comment: GDACS native event identifier (e.g. 1001067 for BERYL-24)

columns.name: gdacs_episodeid
columns.comment: GDACS episode (advisory) identifier — one episode per ~6h model run

columns.name: valid_time
columns.comment: Timestamp of the episode (most recent advisory included in the cumulative buffer, UTC)

columns.name: wind_speed_kt
columns.comment: Wind speed threshold in knots (34, 50, or 64). GDACS buffer39 maps to 34 kt, buffer74 maps to 64 kt; 50 kt is not produced by GDACS.

columns.name: admin_level
columns.comment: Administrative level (0 = country, 1 = first subnational, etc.)

columns.name: iso3
columns.comment: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (parent country at admin_level=1). Standardized via ocha_lens.datasources.gdacs.to_iso3() — GDACS proprietary codes like XJE (Jersey) are remapped to the official ISO3 (JEY).

columns.name: admin_name
columns.comment: Admin unit name as reported by GDACS — CNTRY_NAME at admin_level=0, ADMIN_NAME at admin_level=1. Always populated.

columns.name: gdacs_admin_code
columns.comment: Native GDACS admin code preserved as-is. At admin_level=0: GMI_CNTRY (= iso3 except for territories with X-prefixed proprietary codes). At admin_level=1: GMI_ADMIN (e.g., USA-ARK for Arkansas, XJE-JE for Jersey-as-region) — country-prefixed proprietary, not a standard humanitarian pcode.

columns.name: pcode
columns.comment: Admin unit p-code. Nullable: populated as iso3 at admin_level=0; null at admin_level=1 until backfilled by a downstream enrichment step (GDACS only emits proprietary FIPS_ADMIN/GMI_ADMIN codes, not standard pcodes).

columns.name: pop_exposed
columns.comment: Population count exposed within this admin unit to this wind buffer, as reported by GDACS. NULL when GDACS legitimately omits POP_AFFECTED (typically: country intersected the wind footprint geometrically but no population is exposed at that wind threshold).

columns.name: adam_eventid
columns.comment: ADAM native event identifier (integer; ADAM also exposes a string ``uid`` field which is not stored here)

columns.name: adam_episodeid
columns.comment: ADAM episode identifier — one episode per advisory; latest-per-event used in the historical compile

columns.name: valid_time
columns.comment: Timestamp of the episode (most recent advisory included in the cumulative footprint, UTC)

columns.name: wind_speed_kt
columns.comment: Wind speed threshold in knots (34, 50, or 64). ADAM 60/90/120 km/h thresholds are mapped to 34/50/64 kt for cross-source comparability.

columns.name: admin_level
columns.comment: Administrative level (0 = country, 1 = first subnational, 2 = second subnational). ADAM CSV is at admin_level=2; admin_level=0 and =1 rows are aggregated by the pipeline.

columns.name: iso3
columns.comment: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (parent country at admin_level=1,2). Nullable when ADAM's ADM0_NAME cannot be mapped via pycountry + overrides (rare: disputed territories).

columns.name: admin_name
columns.comment: Admin unit name as reported by ADAM — ADM0_NAME at admin_level=0, ADM1_NAME at admin_level=1, ADM2_NAME at admin_level=2. Always populated.

columns.name: parent_admin_name
columns.comment: Name of the parent admin unit — null at admin_level=0, ADM0_NAME at admin_level=1, ADM1_NAME at admin_level=2. Lets consumers walk the hierarchy without joins.

columns.name: pcode
columns.comment: Admin unit p-code. Nullable: populated as iso3 at admin_level=0; null at admin_level=1 until backfilled by a downstream enrichment step (ADAM only emits an admin name at ADM1, no code).

columns.name: pop_exposed
columns.comment: Population count exposed within this admin unit to this wind threshold, as reported by ADAM

columns.name: gdacs_eventid
columns.comment: GDACS native event id. Primary key in the MVP — every row originates from a GDACS event ingest.

columns.name: atcf_id
columns.comment: NHC ATCF storm id (e.g. AL142024); nullable. Populated by run_pipeline.py match.

columns.name: sid
columns.comment: IBTrACS serial id; nullable. Populated by a future IBTrACS-side enrichment step.

columns.name: adam_eventid
columns.comment: WFP ADAM event id; nullable. Often equal to gdacs_eventid (ADAM ingests GDACS upstream), confirmed by a future ADAM-side enrichment step.

columns.name: last_updated
columns.comment: Auto-set on insert; bump on update via the matching pipeline if you want to track linkage churn.
